# R6.39 — E2-T7 + E2-T8(a): `exec_defaults` exec semantics + HH-native topology spike (manifest 298)

Harness: devin-cli / swe-2-high / subagent — engineered (offline, $0.00)

Two-stage ticket. Stage 1 lands the AR-22 `exec_defaults{timeout_ms,
stdio, cwd, env}` semantics end to end (G17): capability member → typed
decode at arm → `ExecutionRequest` → helper wire → helper spawn →
result render. Stage 2 (E2-T8 (a)) runs the HH-native participant
spike — `hh-kernel` as a child process over binding (b), sole writer of
the slot store during the agent phase, cell custody through
`env.close{detach}`/`env.attach` — and lands the committed C-05 rung
record. REQ-XE-119/120 primary (contrib REQ-XB-103, REQ-XD-201,
REQ-XE-125).

## Stage 1 — `exec_defaults` + helper exec semantics (REQ-XE-119)

- **`hh-hir`** — `ToolCapabilityRecord.exec_defaults: Option<Json>`
  (§5b-owned shape like its siblings); serialized in both semantic and
  version projections when present (capability identity), parsed
  verbatim. Absent ⇒ the pre-admission form, byte-identical (the
  opt-in rule; R6.42 authors it).
- **`hh-env::executor`** — `ExecDefaults{timeout_ms, stdio, cwd, env}`
  strict typed decode: members ⊆ the AR-22 set;
  `stdio ∈ {separate, merged}` (default `separate`);
  `cwd ∈ {image_workdir}` (closed spelling — extension is a dialect
  bump); `env` object of string→string constants;
  `timeout_ms` non-negative int; malformed ⇒ typed
  `EnvError::Unsupported{exec_defaults}`. `ExecutionRequest.exec_defaults`.
- **`hh-embed`** — `ExecCap.exec_defaults` decoded at `arm_session_exec`
  (malformed ⇒ `EmbedError::Refused{exec_defaults:…}` — never a
  mid-dispatch failure); `DispatchInput.exec_defaults` rides to the
  `ExecutionRequest` in `dispatch_at`.
- **`hh-env::helper`** — armed: declared `env` constants merge over the
  projected env (the declaration wins its keys — a declaration is total
  for what it names); `effective_deadline_ms` = `min(ladder,
  timeout_ms)` (a capability can only lower its timeout); `cwd` sends
  the `image_workdir` sentinel; `stdio` goes on the wire. Unarmed ⇒
  every member byte-identical.
- **`hh-helper`** — `HelperRequest::Exec.stdio` (additive member;
  absent ⇒ legacy). `stdio=merged` ⇒ `spawn_pgrp_leader_merged` —
  `setsid` + `dup2(1,2)` in `pre_exec`, one pipe ⇒ one ordered stream
  (mini's `stderr=STDOUT` shape). Container backend + armed +
  `deadline_ms` ⇒ `podman::wrap_kill` — `setsid timeout
  --kill-after=<TERM_GRACE> <deadline>` inside the cell, so the
  deadline's TERM→KILL reaches the whole in-container process tree
  (G17 (d); the host-side pgid kill's reach across `podman exec` is
  UNVERIFIED — the in-cell ladder is the enforcement-of-record, the
  host watcher stays the backstop). `cwd = "image_workdir"` ⇒
  `podman exec` omits `--workdir` (the cell's configured WORKDIR — the
  image/cell-spec value, never a host path); non-container backends
  resolve it to the session's first workspace root. Armed reaps of
  `124`/`137` under a declared deadline record
  `failure{deadline_exceeded}` (the same class the watcher records —
  never a second class).
- **Timeout render** — `render_model_view` maps
  `TerminalStatus::ToolError{Timeout}` to `returncode = -1` +
  `exception_info` = the executor's verbatim failure detail (the
  declared exception text; `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` semantics —
  never the killed 124/137/None). Other classes unchanged.

### AC-1/AC-2 evidence (`crates/hh-helper/tests/r6_39.rs`, 4 passed / 1 live-ignored)

- `ac1_argv_golden_declared_cwd_env_and_incell_kill` — `wrap_kill`

- `ac2_unarmed_exec_argv_byte_identical` — absent `stdio` member ⇒
  `--workdir` present, no wrapper (byte-identical pre-change shape).
- `stdio_member_roundtrips_and_absent_defaults` — wire serde.
- `ac1_merged_order_fixture` — `echo a; echo b >&2; echo c` ⇒ merged
  `a\nb\nc\n` one stream; unmerged `a\nc\n|b\n` two pipes (fixture
  verdict on ordering).
- `live_podman_cell_merged_and_incell_kill` —
  `#[ignore = "live — ADR-0363: scripts/live-verify.sh helper_exec_merged_stdio"]`.
- Timeout → rc −1 render lives in `render_model_view`; the render
  assertion rides the r6_36 record-shape golden (`returncode:-1` +
  `exception_info` inline).

## Stage 2 — HH-native topology spike (REQ-XE-120; E2-T8 (a))

- **`environment_spec`** admits `local_sandboxed` / `local_container`
  through `env.open{connection_info}` — `image` required for
  `local_container` (OCI ref; digest-pinned via R6.9's
  `task_image_ref`), `local_sandboxed` shares the local_host workspace
  convention; `connection_info.cell_spec` → `ext["cell_spec"]` and
  `connection_info.ext` carry verbatim (the R6.9/AR-05 decodes validate
  them — one provisioning path, CC1). Other classes refuse unchanged.
- **`crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_39.rs`** —
  `ac3_two_process_ownership_detach_reattach` (offline, deterministic):
  the slot worker spawns `hh-kernel serve` over binding (b) —
  newline-delimited JSON-RPC on the child's stdio, `HH_STORE_ROOT` =
  the slot store, `HH_HELPER_BIN` to the built helper, `TMPDIR=/tmp`
  (macOS `temp_dir()` overflows SUN_LEN for the helper sock). No crate
  edge — REQ-XB-103 stands; the runner reaches the kernel only as a
  spawned process. Over `hh-embed/1`:
  `hello{experimental, serves_*}` → `open_session{new{definition,
  environment{connection_info{local_sandboxed}}}}` (corpus doc as the
  fixture definition) → the child holds the run's writer (the worker's
  second `acquire_writer` is refused `WouldBlock` at the store's own
  fence — detected, never bypassed) →
  `env.open{connection_info{local_sandboxed}}` provisions the seatbelt
  cell → `env.close{mode:"detach"}` → `env.attach` ⇒
  `{attached:true, state:"ready"}` — **the same cell re-attaches under
  the child's custody** → `close{done}` seals the run
  (`lifecycle.run.finished`) and releases the writer → the worker's
  takeover `acquire_writer` succeeds at the fence → a fresh
  `EnvDriver` re-attaching the durable `Detached` handle post-seal
  refuses typed (recorded — never papered over).
  `live_kernel_child_cell_custody` is `#[ignore]`'d under ADR-0363.

### C-05 rung record — rung 1

`docs/build/reports/r6-39-c05-rung.md` (committed): **rung 1 — the
detach/reattach spike passes** on the offline fixture host (macOS
arm64, seatbelt). Rung 2 (child keeps custody *through* seal+verify)
not reached — the custody return runs through `close` (run seals →
worker takes the writer back), so the child was not writer at seal;
left UNVERIFIED. Rung 3 unreached ⇒ no AR-04 amendment drafted, no
insert request raised; HH-native slot launch stays refused typed
(X-01). The HH-native model lane through R6.12's replay proxy is
R6.41's scope — the rung-1 fixture drives the scripted/open path, no
model leg claimed.

## Deviations

- `check-removability` extension-section failure is pre-existing
  (verified byte-identical on `origin/main`).
- `attach`/`resume` open paths could not serve the writer-session leg:
  `attach` is read-only by construction and `resume{takeover}` needs a
  checkpoint — the fixture uses `open_session{new}` (the slot-packet
  shape) instead; recorded in the test's comments.
- `env.attach` re-attach exercised in-session (child custody); the
  worker-side post-seal `EnvDriver` re-attach refuses typed — the
  recorded rung-1 boundary.
